structure.unit: Uniform Real Property Transfer on Death Act

law.catch_line: Relation to federal Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act
law.text: This article modifies, limits, and supersedes the federal Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act, 15 U.S.C. § 7001 et seq., but does not modify, limit, or supersede § 101(c) of that Act, 15 U.S.C. § 7001(c), or authorize electronic delivery of any of the notices described in § 103(b) of that Act, 15 U.S.C. § 7003 (b).
